text: This report provides information on the status of the Exhibition Place health and safety system, specifically on activities, priorities, and performance during the fourth quarter of 2020, as well as, overall health and safety performance for the year 2020. There were 0 lost time injuries and a 60 percent decrease in the number of medical aid injuries in 2020 relative to 2019. Workplace Safety and Insurance Board (WSIB) invoiced costs for 2020 were 5 percent higher to those in 2019.
The Board of Governors of Exhibition Place: 1. Received the report (February 4, 2021) from the Chief Executive Office, Exhibition Place for information.
